statement:
The airspace record lists sector 7 status as open (with ban hours 12:00-23:00).  
I will hold because the given facts establish a flight ban in force over closed airspace today.
Survey flight SV-19 over sector 7 is on hold (closed airspace / flight ban in force).
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the flight cannot proceed because "the given facts establish a flight ban in force over closed airspace today," contradicting the record's "open" status.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
